name: Backroad Recovery Epsom Salt Soak
blurb: Peppermint, lavender, black pepper, and ylang ylang for whatever the backroads (or the day) put you through. Stir a scoop into a warm bath, soak 20 to 30 minutes, come out looser than you went in.
ingredients: Essential Oils (Peppermint, Lavender, Black Pepper, Ylang Ylang)

usageGuide.howToApply: Add 1/2 cup into hot bathwater, breathe in the clearing herbal steam, and soak for 20–30 minutes while the day's work washes off.
usageGuide.storage: Store in a cool, dry location with bag sealed tight. Shelf life is 12 months.
usageGuide.patchTest: Contains potent peppermint and eucalyptus essential oils. Test on forearm before first full soak; avoid eye contact.
